description: Polish company extract from the National Court Register (KRS). Current KRS extract by 10-digit KRS number: name, legal form, NIP, REGON, registration date, address, website, share capital, main activity, the representation rule and board roles. Personal names are masked by the register itself. Use for KYB in Poland. Price $0.020 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
